decision: CONSENT. The subject is unmoved at the dispatched digest 8f30fd4a… and mode 0444, and the frozen turn-1 subject is unmoved at 128488c6… and unedited. The single turn-1 MUST-FIX landed and landed correctly: the decision-type limb now reads 'D-170 through D-235 and D-237', and git is dispositive that this is exactly the set of no-cell-edit decisions in that window — fc688b1 (D-236) is the sole file-08 commit inside D-170..D-237, the next-most-recent file-08 commits are D-169, D-167 and D-158 below the range floor, and D-237's commit 0a814f9 carries no file-08 path. The repair therefore neither omits a member nor admits a false one, and it preserves rather than overwrites the boundary D-237 established under its own three-turn protocol. All thirteen cited digests recompute exactly, both Stage A verdicts are ACCEPT 0/0 at mode 0444, and the Stage A honesty clause survives its sharpest attack: v7's top-level namedCorpusNotAuthored is non-empty, but the subject's qualifier 'on OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING' names the obligation-level field, which is [] — the same locus the Stage A observation's own 'where' field identifies. Every live figure re-measured independently from file 08 at HEAD matches the subject: required-now 28 of 28, owners 32 of 32, last gate row DR-G32, DR-G23 OPEN, DR-133 OPEN, condition 2 at 5 of 32, condition 4 MET on the naming half, naming parent D-147. All nineteen dispatch attacks fail, and ten independent attacks beyond the dispatch list fail as well, including a full diff of the frozen turn-1 subject against turn 2 that shows no substantive change smuggled in under cover of the repair: every prohibition line, both Decision items, Readiness effect and Reversibility are byte-identical to turn 1, and the delta is the one-sentence repair plus house-convention turn-2 custody. Two observations are recorded and neither is scored: an 83-character unwrapped line produced by the clause insertion, which is typographic, has zero scope effect and reproduces an artefact present in the adopted D-217 turn-2 draft; and the fact that the D238-SF-1 row could not be cross-checked at source because the dispatch forbids reading the other reviewer, a boundary of this review rather than a defect in the subject. Zero MUST-FIX, zero SHOULD-FIX.
